appliedUpdates.description: Document integration test harness pattern: each test file in launa-integration-tests/tests/ builds its own harness struct (SpaSim + SpaApp + SimBroker + VirtualClock + FrameDecoder) with methods tick_spa, tick_app, advance_ms, complete_registration, process_outgoing, execute_actions_on_broker. Multiple harnesses exist: SpaAppTestHarness, TempPhysicsHarness, BusDegradationHarness, FaultTimerHarness, ConfigValidationHarness.

Document SpaSim fault lifecycle and power cycle APIs: simulate_fault_state(FaultCode), clear_fault_state(), set_fault_log_config(FaultLogConfig), simulate_spa_reboot(). These are now stable simulation APIs used across multiple integration test features.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance for integration test harness conventions: when to extend existing SpaAppTestHarness vs. creating a custom harness per test file. Currently workers create custom harnesses for each feature, leading to 5+ harness structs with duplicated boilerplate (tick_spa, process_outgoing, complete_registration, execute_actions_on_broker). Consider recommending extension or a shared trait.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: integration-config-validation created ConfigValidationHarness, integration-bus-degradation created BusDegradationHarness, integration-temperature-physics created TempPhysicsHarness, integration-fault-timers created FaultTimerHarness — all duplicating the same core wiring logic.

rejectedObservations.observation: The rust-worker skill's procedure was followed (TDD, test first, verify workspace, cargo fmt). No skill gaps identified.
rejectedObservations.reason: Already documented in skill procedure; not new knowledge
